context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 156 tested the new Coach/Physio landing pages and Pro Application system. Backend APIs verified: GET /api/pro/application/contract/{coach|physio}, POST /api/pro/application (auto-validates), GET /api/pro/application/check/{phone}. Frontend landing pages at /become-pro?type=coach (purple theme) and /become-pro?type=physio (green theme) with 3-step multi-step form (Info, Qualifications, Contract & Signature). ThemeContext defaults to 'light' mode.
